order.title: KERC Combined Tariff Order 2025 for BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM and GESCOM (control period FY2025-26 to FY2027-28), FY2026-27 column

categories.name: LT-1 Domestic
categories.description: Lighting, heating and motive power in residential houses, including erstwhile Bhagyajyothi/Kutirjyothi installations. Since Tariff Order 2025, one statewide slab with no rural/urban or load split. Tariff applies from the first meter reading on or after 1 April 2026.

energy.note: KERC merged the two-tier LT-1 structure into a single slab in Tariff Order 2025 (p.217).

cite.quote: Energy Charges (Per kWh) 580 Paise 580 Paise 575 Paise

fixed.note: Billing load is the higher of sanctioned load and recorded maximum demand on static/smart meters; fractions rounded to the nearest quarter kW, minimum 1 kW. The engine bills sanctioned load.

cite.quote: Fraction of KW / HP shall be rounded off to the nearest quarter KW / HP for purpose of billing and the minimum billing being for 1 KW

charges.name: P&G surcharge (Government portion of pension and gratuity)
charges.note: FY2025-26 Rs 0.36, FY2026-27 Rs 0.35, FY2027-28 Rs 0.34 per kWh, shown as a separate line on monthly bills.

charges.name: FPPCA (fuel and power purchase cost adjustment)
charges.note: Set monthly per ESCOM. No official current value was found; news in October 2026 reported an expected 40-50 paise/unit for the Oct-Nov 2026 cycle, not confirmed as KERC-approved. Placeholder 0 until a notified value is added.

cite.quote: ESCOMs are complying by including these arrears in monthly FPPCA charges.

charges.name: Electricity Tax (Government of Karnataka)
charges.note: Ad valorem on charges for electricity consumed, excluding arrears. Applied here to energy and fixed charges; whether it also applies to the P&G surcharge and FPPCA lines is not confirmed.

cite.quote: the Electricity Tax is levied at 9% on advolorem basis on the charges payable on electricity sold to or consumed by any consumer excluding arrears

charges.name: Rooftop solar fixed-charge rebate
charges.note: LT domestic installations up to 10 kW sanctioned load with rooftop solar get Rs 25/kW of installed solar off fixed charges. Per-month application is inferred from fixed charges being per kW per month.

cite.quote: The eligible consumers shall be allowed a rebate of Rs.25/kW in fixed charges for the installed SRTPV capacity.

subsidies.name: Gruha Jyothi
subsidies.eligibility: Registered domestic connections (Seva Sindhu, Aadhaar linked). Entitlement is the household's FY2022-23 monthly average plus 10%, capped at 200 units; new connections get 53 units. Within entitlement: zero bill. Above entitlement up to 200 units: the eligible amount is deducted. Above 200 units: full bill that month.
subsidies.solarInteraction: Not specified in the fetched orders.

cite.quote: If my monthly consumption is more than 200 units? Will I have to pay the entire bill amount? Yes for that particular month alone you will have to pay the entire bill amount.
the eligible units--determined as the average electricity consumption for the financial year 2022-23 plus an additional 10%--will continue to remain unchanged

regimes.label: Net metering (KERC DSPV Regulations 2026)

exportRate.basis: KERC DSPV tariff for domestic 1-10 kW without capital subsidy, new projects 25.08.2026 to 30.06.2029, fixed for the 25-year PPA

regimes.note: Monthly settlement with no banking: surplus export over import is bought at the PPA tariff each month. Fixed charges and levies are always payable. Systems commissioned 01.07.2025-24.08.2026 keep the earlier tariff (Rs 3.86; PM Surya Ghar 2.30/2.48/2.93).

cite.quote: For grid connected Distributed Solar PV Plants under net-metering/gross metering/net billing of 1 kW to 10 kW for domestic consumers, the approved tariff is Rs. 3.89 per unit, without capital subsidy.
Excess energy exported, if any and purchased by the Distribution Licensee at the PPA tariff, and amount settled on monthly basis.

exportRate.basis: Same DSPV tariff as net metering

cite.quote: Energy Bill of consumer = Fixed Charges + Other applicable charges and levies + (EDL x TRST) - (ERE x TRR)

exportRate.basis: Entire generation bought at the DSPV tariff

cite.quote: The distribution licensee shall purchase entire energy generated from the DSPV system at the tariff determined by the Commission.

capacityLimit.note: Net metering: 1 kW up to the lower of sanctioned load and 1000 kW. Up to 10 kW, DC capacity may exceed the AC inverter rating by 10%, but the inverter must not exceed sanctioned load.

rooftopSolar.fees: No fee schedule in the 2026 Regulations. A BESCOM 2023 guideline hosted on MESCOM's SRTPV portal lists Rs 1,500 + GST (registration + facilitation) for 1-5 kWp and Rs 5,000 + GST for 5-50 kWp, plus Rs 10 e-sign for domestic 1-10 kW. MESCOM says these fees apply under PM Surya Ghar too.
notes: Grid support charges on rooftop solar are barred until KERC determines them (order of 15.01.2025).
No Karnataka state top-up over PM Surya Ghar CFA was found in primary sources.

gaps: FPPCA: no official current monthly value for any ESCOM; modelled as 0 (unverified). Oct 2026 news reports 40-50 paise/unit expected for Oct-Nov billing.

FY25 true-up charges (MESCOM refund 9 paise/unit, BESCOM recovery 56 paise/unit) are computed on each consumer's FY2024-25 consumption and spread over May 2026-April 2027 bills; not modelled because they do not depend on current consumption. Sources: mescom-apr-2026, bescom-apr-2026.

Gruha Jyothi: a January 2024 news report says the +10% buffer became +10 units; the GO was not found and BESCOM's July 2026 FAQ still says +10%. How fixed charges and tax are treated above the entitlement is not specified; the engine bills the units above the entitlement as a separate smaller bill.
Electricity tax base beyond energy and fixed charges (P&G surcharge, FPPCA) is not confirmed.
Billing load uses recorded maximum demand when higher than sanctioned load; the engine uses sanctioned load.

PDF sources were hashed on 2026-10-29 where the host allowed it; sources without sha256 could not be fetched (regulator site refused the connection) or are web pages, which change too often to fingerprint.
